source_visual_observations: Three vertical dashed parallels l,m,n; B on n, C on m, A left of l. BC/n25°, ACB60°, α at AC/l.
audit.independent_solution: BC makes25° with each vertical parallel. At C, angleACB=60° consists of that25° angle plus the angle between CA and the upward vertical. Thus α=60−25=35°, choice C.
